caption: The drawing is bordered with a wide floral frame composed of clusters of orange, pink, and red flowers with green leaves. Inside the border, the top section contains a four-line inscription in light blue text. Beneath the text, the central scene depicts an outdoor setting with a white picket fence, a tree with green foliage and brown branches, and a house or building with blue-gray walls and a brown roof in the background. There are three human figures: a woman seated on a red bench to the right, holding a piece of cloth or object in her hands, and two children standing to the left, one wearing a blue outfit and the other a red dress and bonnet. The ground is depicted with green grass and small patches of flowers. At the bottom, just above the border, the name "Mary S.C. Burchfield. East Liberty." is written in red text. The overall composition uses muted, pastel colors and delicate line work.
title: Sampler - Mary S. C. Burchfield
